name: Persistent goal runtime
summary: A goal is represented as durable runtime state rather than ordinary chat text, allowing agent work to resume after compaction, restart, or terminal closure.
notes: Specific product claims should be attached as source records before publication as verified facts.

name: Stateful loop continuity
summary: A lightweight loop repeatedly re-reads an instruction file and updates durable state files between agent invocations.
notes: Useful as a baseline harness even when richer goal runtimes exist.

name: Campaign worktree control plane
summary: A control plane coordinates multiple agents across isolated worktrees with persisted campaign state, retries, policy checks, and audit logs.
notes: This is the main harness family for scaling Open Harness Hub object factories safely.

name: Backend harness API
summary: A service accepts a goal, environment capability set, verification policy, and budget envelope, then drives an agent and returns a traceable outcome.
notes: This pattern connects the LLM pipeline SaaS idea to durable orchestration.

name: Meta-harness evolver
summary: A harness whose job is to propose, test, compare, and safely update other harnesses using benchmark traces and isolated branches.
notes: Meta-harnesses should not be allowed to silently weaken safety gates or validation criteria.
